subject.title: TUI: Support Shift+Enter for newline (Enter to send)

question: Should this issue be narrowed to documenting the existing pi-tui newline shortcuts, or should OpenClaw add a first-class configurable TUI send/newline keybinding surface?
rationale: Current main already gets newline insertion from pi-tui, but a configurable Enter/Ctrl+Enter/Shift+Enter mode would create a new user-facing config or CLI contract that automation should not choose alone.

options.title: Document Existing Behavior First
options.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings until maintainers approve the config shape.

options.title: Add Configurable TUI Keybindings
options.body: Introduce a maintainer-approved config or CLI bridge into the TUI editor keybindings with tests for default compatibility and the alternate send/newline mode.

options.title: Close As Partial Implementation
options.body: Close if maintainers consider dependency-backed Shift+Enter/Ctrl+J support enough and do not want docs/help or configurable keybinding work tracked here.

recommendation.title: Document Existing Behavior First
recommendation.body: Update docs and /help with Shift+Enter, Ctrl+J, terminal limitations, and fallback behavior while deferring configurable keybindings until maintainers approve the config shape.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from current TUI editor/docs history and the prior issue review scoping the remaining decision.
